Subject: Quick follow-up: token volumes & budgeting

Thanks for the demo today — it was helpful to see the latency and cost controls. A quick recap from our side so we can move toward procurement: we estimate the following steady-state monthly volumes if the pilot is successful:

- Generative chat (customer-facing): ~40,000,000 tokens/month
- Embeddings (semantic search + personalization): ~5,000,000 tokens/month
- Reranking (re-rank candidate lists): ~1,000,000 tokens/month

Budget range: our initial budget target for the proof-of-concept + month-1 production is $20k–$32k / month. That translates to an implied target of roughly $300–$500 per 1M tokens across the blended workload. We realize unit economics change by model and by whether features like streaming, KV cache, or dedicated lanes are used.

Questions we have for the follow-up:
- Can you provide a baseline $/1M token for a hosted config, broken down by model class (chat / embedding / rerank)?
- Any quick recommendations on model choices that balance quality and cost for these workloads?
- Do you see obvious levers (quantization, batching policy) that can push blended cost toward the low end of our budget?

Procurement: looping in our procurement team (procurement@brightlytics.com) for high-level next steps — they will need a short pilot SOW and an estimated monthly invoice for the first 3 months.

Thanks — Priya

Priya Sharma
Director of Product

Priya — really helpful numbers, thanks. Consolidating next steps and a concrete costing playbook so procurement has what it needs. Short version up top, details below.

Top-line proposal (hosted API, month-1 pilot -> month-3 steady state):
- Blended volumes (as you specified): chat 40M / mo, embeddings 5M / mo, rerank 1M / mo.
- Suggested model mix (to hit quality vs cost targets):
  - chat: open-llm-chat-v1 (default) — 80% of tokens
  - embedding: embed-sim-v1 — 12% of tokens
  - rerank: rerank-proto-v1 — 8% of tokens
- Baseline hosted pricing (indicative, pre-negotiation):
  - open-llm-chat-v1 (chat): $420 per 1M tokens
  - embed-sim-v1 (embeddings): $95 per 1M tokens (embedding unit = 1k vectors equiv)
  - rerank-proto-v1 (rerank): $280 per 1M tokens
- Blended target and how we get there: current baseline blended: ~$370 / 1M tokens. With suggested levers below we estimate we can reach ~$290 / 1M tokens within pilot.

Key cost levers we will run during the pilot:
- Quantization/Model Variant: move chat to q4 quantized variant for non-critical paths (saves 25–40% cost with <2% quality delta on most prompts).
- Prefix KV caching: for repeated prompts in chat flows, expect 6–12% token savings on average.
- Continuous batching policy: increase batching window by 15ms in lower-latency routes to pick up 8–12% efficiency.
- Hybrid routing: route lower-priority chat to cheaper model variant during peak to hold SLA while lowering unit costs.

Pilot scope and deliverables:
- 4-week technical pilot: integration support, instrumentation (latency + token breakdown), and an evaluation prompt set to track quality regressions.
- Business pilot: two-week price validation window with real traffic throttled to 25–50% of target to measure realized token mix and unit price.
- Deliverables: MAP_BrightLytics_v1.pdf (attached), sample pricing sheet (Redwood-pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx), and a pilot SOW outline.

Next steps / asks from BrightLytics:
1) Confirmation on the proposed model mix above (chat/embeddings/rerank). If you prefer a higher-quality chat model for the initial pilot, we can swap open-llm-chat-v1 -> open-llm-chat-highq at approx +25% cost.
2) Procurement contact and target date to receive the pilot SOW / PO.
3) Any compliance requirements (SOC2 evidence, IPAck) we should attach to the SOW.

I'll attach the MAP and a pricing worksheet. If that looks good I can send a one-page SOW and a pilot invoice estimate for procurement. Proposed check-in: Wed Aug 5th 10:00am PT for a 30-minute alignment with your procurement and engineering.
